# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 51 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39-40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_051_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 51

**1** His disciples said to him: "When will the dead find rest? When will the new world come?"

**2** He said: "What you're looking for is already here — you just don't see it."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "When will the dead find rest?" — the disciples' eschatological hope rendered as a question about the dead
- "Already here" — the realized eschatology rendered as presence
- "You just don't see it" — the blindness rendered conversationally
